name: Webflow
rationale: An inspired interpretation of Webflow's design language — a visual web development platform whose surface contrasts a deep near-black `#080808` primary against a generous white canvas, broken by a fiv
visual_style: An inspired interpretation of Webflow's design language — a visual web development platform whose surface contrasts a deep near-black `#080808` primary against a generous white canvas, broken by a five-stop chromatic accent system (purple / pink / blue / orange / green) that maps to the brand's product categories, and anchored by the proprietary WF Visual Sans family used at restrained 500 / 600 weights with negative tracking.

typography.fontFamily: WF Visual Sans Variable, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
typography.monoFamily: WFVisualSans-Mono, Inconsolata, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

responsive: Mobile-first; stack columns below md; hide sidebar behind menu on sm
